description: Builds ZAISRV (*SRVPGM: get/reserve/release, solutions/07-05/zaisrv.rpgle + zaisrv.bnd) and a new ZAISRVBD (*BNDDIR) - kept separate from JUCSRVBD per the source's own driver.rpgle design (design doc's open §9 item 10 on JUCSRVBD-vs-ZAISRVBD reuse is left unresolved by this manifest; this reflects what the committed driver.rpgle source actually references). Compiles and runs driver.rpgle ONCE - per the design's own corrected understanding (ileconcepts75.txt: a system-named ACTGRP(*NEW) activation group is deleted the instant its oldest call-stack entry returns), every one of driver.rpgle's test steps (normal reserve, a SHORT reserve exercising the lock-release fix, a same-execution double-reserve for lock-carryover, and its own independent lock-conflict diagnostic) MUST happen inside this single CALL - never split across two separate CALL steps, which would each get an unrelated fresh activation group and could never observe anything about lock persistence either way. IMPORTANT SIDE EFFECT: this mutates the shared ZAIKOM table (same table R0409A/F0608A already write to). 2026-09-26 additions (advisor-flagged gaps): (1) driver.rpgle, like F0607A/F0608A in part06-0509-procs-files, only writes to `dcl-f qsysprt printer(132)` (confirmed by grep, driver.rpgle:238) - none of its lock-test results were previously captured. Added the same VSPLPF (CHKOBJ+conditional-CRTPF) idiom plus a CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) step after RUNDRIVER, and a matching collect. (2) This manifest now runs TXRESET itself at the end (`&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)`, a library-qualified command invocation - TXRESET is a pre-existing, already hardware-confirmed *CMD, docs/probes.md:219), plus a collect reading ZAIKOM back afterward as evidence the reset took effect, replacing the previous informational-message-only reminder that whoever ran this batch had to remember to run TXRESET themselves as a separate step (04-13, 06-07's exercise, 06-11b, and 06-15's checkpoint all depend on ZAIKOM's known values).

steps.label: CPZAISSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/ZAISRV) MODULE(&LIB/ZAISRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZAISBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJ((*LIBL/ZAISRV *SRVPGM))

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 7 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPDRIVER
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
